### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Harbor Street Patients.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Side effects | 83 | 500 |
| Younger adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Side effects | 123 | 500 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
